There is no elemental weakness; the three NPC forms (2481/2482/2483) all count for the task.

methods.label: Low-level training
methods.summary: Use the dense first-level Minotaurs as free-to-play early combat and Slayer training since no Slayer level is required.
requiredOrKeyItems: Any weapon (melee, ranged, or magic all hit easily)
steps: Clear Minotaurs in the Vault of War for combat and Slayer XP plus the Stronghold reward.
Any combat style works given the -21 defensive bonuses.
Complete the 10-20 assignment before returning to Turael or Spria.

body:
# Minotaur

Minotaurs are a free-to-play low-level Slayer task assigned by Turael and Spria, found on the first level (Vault of War) of the Stronghold of Security beneath Barbarian Village. They have 10 Hitpoints and Defence 10 with all defensive bonuses -21, so any weapon is extremely accurate against them - use whatever you train with and a Slayer helmet. Their max hit is only 2, so barely any food is needed, making them ideal early combat and Slayer training.
